## Checklist

- [ ] `tokens.json` `meta.version` bumped (if values changed)
- [ ] `tokens.json` `meta.updated` date updated
- [ ] `package.json` `version` matches `tokens.json` version
- [ ] `node scripts/validate.js` passes locally
- [ ] `node scripts/build.js` ran (generated files committed)
- [ ] `node scripts/test.js` passes
- [ ] Light + dark mode verified visually
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under the new version
- [ ] If breaking, `MIGRATION.md` updated with upgrade steps

## Type of change

- [ ] Patch — color tweak, value adjustment, doc update
- [ ] Minor — new tokens or generator features
- [ ] Major / breaking — token removal, structural change, or changed contract
